newsitem.title: CHINA: GYMNASTICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION LI XIAOSHUANG INJURED.
newsitem.headline: GYMNASTICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION LI XIAOSHUANG INJURED.

text.p: China's Li Xiaoshuang, men's all-round gymnastics champion at the Atlanta Olympics, has undergone an operation after injuring his ankles in training, the China Sports Daily said on Thursday.
Li injured ligaments in both ankles during exercises about a month ago, the newspaper said.

"I had not expected the boat to capsize in such a little stream," Li was quoted as saying. "This was perhaps because I had rested for quite a long time and my body had not completely made the transition."
This week, Li appeared in a wheelchair when he won an award in ceremonies to name China's top 10 athletes for 1997. It was the fifth time Li had been named among the top 10.
"The surgery was successful and he will recover soon. Actually, he could leave hospital now if he wanted," an official at the Beijing Medical College Number Three Hospital said.
